youtube.baslik: Why does your voice sound different on a recording? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Sound reaches the cochlea not only through the air but also through vibration of the skull bones, called bone conduction. One reason our recorded voice sounds different is that we also hear ourselves by bone conduction while speaking.

bilgiler: Sound can reach the cochlea through skull vibration: bone conduction.
This route largely bypasses the outer and middle ear.
While speaking, we also hear ourselves by bone conduction.
